#!/bin/sh
set -eu

DATA_DIR="/var/lib/inventory"
OUT_FILE="$DATA_DIR/inventory.log"

while :; do
    printf '%s host=%s pid=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$(hostname)" "$$" >> "$OUT_FILE"
    sleep 10
done

[Unit]
Description=Inventory worker (sandboxed background service)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventory-worker
Group=inventory-worker
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
Restart=on-failure

# Confinement: writable only inside /var/lib/inventory
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory
PrivateTmp=true

# No privilege gain
NoNewPrivileges=true
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
RestrictSUIDSGID=true

# Extra hardening
PrivateDevices=true
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectKernelLogs=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
ProtectClock=true
ProtectHostname=true
RestrictNamespaces=true
LockPersonality=true
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true
RestrictRealtime=true
SystemCallFilter=@system-service
SystemCallArchitectures=native
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
